content.context: Pushed unified commit [944d7c7] to GitLab pitmhs/pitmry with devl.dev timeline subsystem, @coss split-resizable diff viewer, Efferd app shell, z-index hierarchy fixes, and complete documentation.
content.decision:
feat: integrate devl.dev timelines, split-resizable diff viewer, and comprehensive docs

- Integrate 4 devl.dev timeline components: status page with 60-day uptime bars, multi-repo deploys tracker, sticky activity feed, and notification center with polling toast engine.
- Integrate @coss split-resizable code diff viewer with 4 view modes (Inline, Split, Preview, Resizable), syntax highlighting, delta badge, and dual copy actions.
- Integrate Efferd app-shell-4 with collapsible icon-rail sidebar (Cmd+B), active breadcrumbs, and single nested container layout.
- Fix z-index stacking context hierarchy (header z-40, popovers z-50, toasts z-[90], diff viewer modal z-[100]).
- Extend /api/memory route with health, deploys, activity, and notifications actions.
- Rewrite README.md and package.json with complete system architecture, data models, and ASD-STE100 Simple English guidelines.
- Export conversation history and architectural thought process to docs/sessions.
content.rationale: Unified all revamp work, layout improvements, and session audit history into production repository.
